decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed conversion of the garage to a habitable room would, by 
            reason of its size, position and appearance  in relation to  neighbouring    
            residential properties, be unduly obtrusive, detrimental to the amenities of 
            adjoining occupiers and the streetscene and is contrary to the Policies  ENVB 
            1.1 (New Development)   and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the  
             Unitary Development Plan, (adopted 2003).     

          2/  The proposed development would result in inadequate off-street parking  being          provided within the curtillage of the site  and the proposal would be likely to give rise          to conditions prejudicial to the free flow of traffic and general safety on the adjoining          highway.   The proposal is therefore contrary to policy  T 1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking         and Servicing Facilities for Developments) and  T 4.4 (Road Safety), of the the         Unitary Development Plan, (adopted 2003).
description: Conversion of garage to habitable room
